violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. -Employee doing all the food prep and cooking switched gloves and tasks several times without washing hands.
Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not covered or inverted during storage. -Clean plates out front in food prep area are not inverted.
